title: Low-rank Grothendieck rings: an AI-assisted classification project, constructions, and open problems
summary: We present a public research project on the Grothendieck rings of complex fusion categories of rank at most eight. The project reports unrestricted classification theorems in ranks two, three, and four, and classifications within specified fusion-multiplicity bounds in ranks five through eight, with two rank-six categorification questions unresolved. Its resources include research manuscripts, an exact fusion-ring census, verification code, and an interactive atlas.
